text: child-page activities that need many short-lived visual elements use small DOM nodes with CSS keyframes and timer-based removal (ogrod.js) or a single canvas (akwarium.js); the global prefers-reduced-motion rule in style.css disables all animations, so removal must not depend on transitionend.
Reviewer check: compare the PR file list (gh pr view --json files) with what the description and index.html reference; a new activity JS file can be left untracked and missing from the commit.
When a reviewer reports a file missing from a PR, check git and disk first; it may never have been saved, so re-implement it from the PR description plus the existing CSS and HTML.
In this environment, run git as `git -C <dir>`; `cd <dir> && git ...` triggers an approval prompt and fails in unattended runs.
Reviewer check: Developer PRs can be stacked on unmerged sibling feature branches, so the diff against main includes other activities' files; note the merge order in the review.
child-page: the .n-lines SVG uses preserveAspectRatio=none; with vector-effect non-scaling-stroke removed, stroke widths and dasharrays in css/style.css are in viewBox (0-100) units, not pixels.
Reviewer check: activity buttons wired only to pointerdown with preventDefault() are not keyboard-activatable (Enter/Space fire click); note as a minor non-blocking suggestion.
Reviewer check: gh pr checkout can leave a stale detached HEAD from another branch; verify with `git fetch origin <branch>` and read files via `git show FETCH_HEAD:<path>`.

Reviewer check: for spring/physics-based motion, re-simulate the update step in Node (redirect mid-flight, landing time) to verify AC claims about continuity and duration instead of trusting the PR description.

Reviewer check: when a PR is re-labelled ready-for-review with an unchanged head sha, compare it with the previously reviewed sha first; if unchanged, post a short re-confirmation rather than a full re-review, and don't implement human-requested fixes yourself.

Reviewer check: in child-page akwarium.js the wall-avoidance margin must scale with turn radius (speed/turnRate), otherwise fish pin against walls on wide screens; margin ≈ 0.16·width is safe against overlap.

child-page: activity elements that must be keyboard-accessible need tabindex=0 plus a keydown handler for Enter/Space alongside pointerdown, and a :focus-visible outline in css/style.css; position dynamic nodes in percent so they survive orientation changes.
child-page: for keyboard activation of pointerdown-wired buttons, add a click listener guarded by e.detail === 0 (Enter/Space) and remove both listeners in the mount cleanup.

Reworker: the revisions-required label may show as 'revisions-required:wip' claim label; `gh pr edit --remove-label revisions-required` still works. child-page has no test suite, so verify JS with `node --check`.
child-page originally had no web app manifest, icons or service worker, so Chrome 'install' on Android only created a broken shortcut; installability/offline is tracked as a separate feature issue.

child-page: don't rely on SVG pathLength with stroke-dasharray for line-draw effects (unreliable across browsers); set the real length via a --len CSS variable computed in JS and use it for dasharray/dashoffset.

Reworker: `git merge` fails in this env without an identity; export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL (and GIT_AUTHOR_*) before merging main into a PR branch, then finish with `gh-as-agent commit` and `gh-as-agent push --repo <clone>` run from inside the clone dir.

child-page: the agent sandbox denies edits to .github/workflows/*; when a feature needs a pages.yml change (e.g. copying new top-level files into _site/), flag the exact change in a PR comment for a human instead of retrying.

child-page originally required 'no data stored'; features needing persistence (e.g. playtime timer) must explicitly relax that rule for minimal local-only storage and define a parent gate for any parent-facing Settings.

child-page: activities mount inside .stage, and the global `.stage svg {width:120px;height:120px}` rule (specificity 0,1,1) overrides single-class SVG sizing like .n-lines; scope activity SVG overlay selectors as `.stage .<class>` or they shrink to 120px and misalign with percent-positioned elements.
Reviewer check: when a child-page SVG overlay looks like a 'smaller separate shape', suspect the global `.stage svg` 120px rule and verify the overlay selector is scoped `.stage .<class>`.
child-page playtime limit design: timer counts only visible activity time, resets automatically each new day, and stores only the limit and time used locally (relaxing the 'no data stored' rule).

child-page: .github/workflows/pages.yml copies an explicit file list with `cp -r` into _site; if the workflow listing new paths (manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, icons) lands on main before the PR that adds them, the deploy job fails, so merge the feature PR first or together.

Reworker: an add/add conflict on a stacked PR's file means main already holds an older copy; keep the PR's newer version with `git checkout --ours <file>` during `git merge origin/main`, then re-check `gh pr view --json mergeable` after a few seconds because GitHub's status lags.

child-page: for SVG parts that must scale around a fixed point (e.g. butterfly wings folding to the body axis), set the SVG transform attribute (scale about user-space origin) from JS; CSS transform-box: view-box with transform-origin percentages ignores an offset viewBox (e.g. -50 -40 100 80) and folds toward the wrong side.

child-page: playtime limit lives in js/playtime.js (window.Playtime: start/stop/isExpired/renderLater) with state in localStorage key 'swa.playtime'; app.js only calls these, and dimming is set from JS (stage opacity) so it survives the global prefers-reduced-motion rule.

Reviewer check: child-page playtime.js re-reads state from localStorage every tick (refresh/load), so when storage throws the in-memory 'used' is discarded and the limit is never enforced; check storage-unavailable fallbacks in any reload-from-storage state code.

child-page playtime.js: when a localStorage write fails, keep an in-memory copy of state and have load() use it (storageOk flag) so refresh-from-storage doesn't discard used time; guard once-only expiry rendering with a per-start flag in app.js.
child-page review feedback is batched into one issue for polish items, with fixes that depend on an unmerged feature PR (e.g. playtime moon-screen fade) split into their own dependent issue.
child-page: Night Sky's .n-msg (Brawo + Dalej) is an absolutely positioned overlay, so the sky square can use nearly the whole short side; keep new message UI outside the sky's square.
child-page: day/night stars and constellation lines live in .dn-stars; use '.stage .dn-stars svg' selectors so the global '.stage svg' 120px rule doesn't shrink overlays.

child-page: gh-as-agent commit/pr must run from inside the clone dir (git -C from the workspace root fails: 'not a git repository'); the Playtime fade-to-moon lives in js/playtime.js renderLater(container, fromActivity) using JS rAF opacity with smoothstep so it survives prefers-reduced-motion.

Reviewer check: child-page PRs whose issue mandates manual browser testing the agent cannot do are accepted by code reading with no label and a human ask for recorded results (precedent: PRs #20, #23).

Reviewer check: child-page Playtime.start() calls stop(), which cancels any running fade and resets stage opacity; any animation started by renderLater before start() in app.js render() is wiped, so check call order when adding state to stop().

child-page: Playtime.start() calls stop() which cancels fades, so in app.js render() call Playtime.start(cb) before Playtime.renderLater(stage); set the shownLater flag before start() since the expiry callback only fires on a later tick.

Reworker: labels like `<outcome>:wip` and `<outcome>:completed` (e.g. ready-for-review:completed, revisions-required:completed) are platform claim/tracking labels set on flow transitions; agents don't manage them, and a human may remove leftovers manually.

Reviewer check: when a fix reorders calls to avoid a cancel/reset side effect (e.g. start() before renderLater()), re-trace the whole flow including later timer ticks and guard flags (shownLater, fading) to confirm the fade is never repainted at full opacity.

child-page playtime.js: paint() must not set stage opacity to 1 at progress >= 1, because the expiry tick calls paint() before onExpire/renderLater reads the current opacity; setting 1 there makes the moon fade jump to full brightness first.

Reviewer check: when a human reports a visual glitch on an animated flow, re-trace the first tick that reaches the end state (e.g. paint() at progress >= 1 before onExpire) for side effects that reset the animated property.

child-page: tap targets for small floating elements (e.g. the day/night bird) need both width and min-height >= 48px; make the button display:flex; align-items:center so the SVG stays centred without changing its drawn size.
child-page Settings (sum gate, limit form, timer reset) lives in js/playtime.js with panes gate-pane/settings-pane in index.html; new parent configuration sections belong behind the same gate.
child-page live app URL is https://bielinskilukasz.github.io/child-page/ (GitHub Pages, owner lowercase); the product name in Polish text is always 'Spokojny Świat Artura' with the diacritic.

child-page Day/Night (js/dzien-i-noc.js): the cloud/bird/night-flyer logic all runs from one rAF loop (cloudTick); night flyers (satellite, blinking airplane) are .dn-fly divs inside .dn-stars, spawned only when progress>=0.95 and target===1, so they fade with the sky and work under prefers-reduced-motion.

Reworker: 'Night Sky' in human feedback can mean either Nocne Niebo (js/niebo.js, star-connecting game) or Day/Night (js/dzien-i-noc.js, whose Big Dipper was the only constellation); when ambiguous, post a blocking PR comment + human-decision-required and aee-ask before editing.

child-page Day/Night: stars added over time are JS-grown (starTick in the shared rAF loop, 1px -> target via smoothstep, transform translate(-50%,-50%) so they grow around their centre) instead of CSS animation, so they survive prefers-reduced-motion; total star count is capped (STAR_CAP).

child-page menu (.tiles in css/style.css) is flex-wrap with a --cols variable (1 portrait phone, 2 default, 3 at >=700px) and centred rows; app.js saves/restores menu scroll (menuScroll) because hiding #menu-view resets window scroll.

child-page: menu enabled/order config lives in js/menu-config.js (window.MenuConfig, localStorage key 'swa.menu', fires a 'menuconfig' document event); app.js builds tiles from MenuConfig.enabledActivities() and treats disabled hashes as the menu; the Settings UI is wired from playtime.js showSettings.
Developer: check `git branch` before committing; when the checked-out branch belongs to another open PR, create the new feature branch first (git checkout -b) so you don't commit onto it.

Reworker: a human PR comment like 'Implement optional suggestions' makes the reviewer's optional suggestions mandatory; the local clone may sit on another branch, so fetch and `git checkout -b
origin/
`, and `git add` before `gh-as-agent commit` (it doesn't stage).

child-page: Android's 'Remove animations' setting maps to prefers-reduced-motion in Chrome, and the global style.css rule disables all CSS animations, so CSS-keyframe-driven effects (garden growth) vanish on such devices; JS rAF motion with a capped dt (akwarium 0.05s, cloudTick 0.1s) slows down on low-fps devices.

Reworker: a stacked PR's base branch is another feature branch (check `gh pr view --json baseRefName`); resolve 'merge conflicts' by merging origin/<base> into the PR branch (with GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER env set, `git -C <dir>` form only; chained `&&` with checkout/merge triggers an approval prompt), keeping the PR's own side for the contested hunk.

child-page: a phone-only report of 'animations missing/slow' on Android was caused by the system 'Usuń animacje' (Remove animations) setting being on; ask the reporter to check it before opening a bug.

child-page Mały Pociąg (js/pociag.js, id 'pociag'): train position is a loop fraction f (0 = off left, 1 = off right) so speed/station survive resize; start/stop use 2s smoothstep speed ramps and the station stop is a cubic Hermite from current speed to 0, all in one rAF loop.

Developer: the sandbox has no browser or jsdom; sanity-check animation/physics logic by running the activity file in node against a hand-made DOM stub (fake requestAnimationFrame, document, window.ACTIVITIES).

Reviewer check: child-page pooled-DOM activities (deszczyk.js) cap live elements by skipping spawn when the pool is full; verify the cap math (clouds × rate × fall time) and that all timing runs in one capped-dt rAF loop that stops when idle.

Developer: for pooled-DOM activities (child-page banki.js) bound the total node count including fading bubbles, not just the alive ones, otherwise rapid tapping lets fading nodes pile up (91 nodes in a stub test before the fix).
child-page deszczyk.js: rainTotal (time toward the next rainbow) only accumulates while bowState === 0 and is reset when a rainbow starts, so rain during a rainbow doesn't chain a second one.

Developer: child-page drag-and-drop activity (js/ksztalty.js, id 'ksztalty') uses per-shape pointer capture, clamps the dragged centre to the viewport, re-lays out on resize/orientationchange (cancelling drags into a glide home), and accumulates rAF dt for the 4s auto-reset so it pauses when the tab is hidden.

Reviewer check: for Hermite/spring stop-planning code (child-page pociag.js), verify monotonicity by simulating random start speeds and distances in Node; a cubic Hermite with end speed 0 is monotone when v0*T <= 3D, and the code's v*T > 2D guard adds a lap.

Reviewer check: for pooled-DOM child-page activities, run the mount function in Node with a stub DOM (fake rAF, createElement, pointer events) under a ~30 taps/s storm to confirm the node count stays bounded and cleanup leaves the scene empty.

Developer: child-page Farma (js/farma.js, id 'farma') is a 4:3 board of square %-positioned buttons each holding an inline SVG; reactions are JS rAF transforms (style.transformOrigin in SVG user px) with a per-animal timer ignoring taps while active; one capped-dt loop that is cancelled when hidden.

child-page Dobranoc (js/dobranoc.js, id 'dobranoc'): 4:3 board of %-positioned native buttons (4 windows, 3 animals); each item has value v and target t eased in one capped-dt rAF loop that stops when idle; the glow target is 1 only when all lights are off and all animals asleep, so every change is reversible and works under prefers-reduced-motion.
Developer: new-activity PRs for child-page are based on the open menu branch (feature/menu-scroll-28), not main, until #35 merges; branch from origin/<that base> and pass --base to gh-as-agent pr.

child-page pociag.js station-stop: cap Hermite duration T at 2.85*D/v (monotone while v*T<=3D) and add a lap only if T would be <2.5s; layout() re-plans an active stop via goStation() so resize doesn't snap.

child-page: sibling activity PRs stacked on feature/menu-scroll-28 all append to the same spots (js/activities.js list end, script tags before app.js, end of css/style.css), so merge conflicts between them are additive: keep both sides, then re-add the trailing comma on the former last activities.js entry and run node --check on every js file.

Reworker: when a human says 'implement the optional suggestions' and one is manual device testing, fix the code ones, post a blocking comment and apply human-decision-required rather than ready-for-review.

Reworker: the hand-off gate holds ready-for-review back when a PR conflicts with its base ('Hand-off held back: merge conflict'), re-setting revisions-required; fix by merging origin/<base>, then re-add ready-for-review and remove stale revisions-required:completed.

child-page banki.js: Back-button/hourglass keep-out is measured each frame from document.querySelector('.back'/'.hourglass') rects (+12px pad) instead of a fixed pixel corner, so safe-area insets and the optional hourglass are handled; tiny bubbles (r <= MIN_R*1.2) fade on touch rather than ignore it.

Reworker: before `git merge` check the current branch with `git branch --show-current`; a failed `checkout -b` (branch already exists) leaves you on the previous branch, and the merge then fast-forwards the wrong one. Use `checkout
` + `reset --hard origin/
` for a stale local branch, and re-fetch the base right before pushing because sibling activity PRs keep landing on it.

Reworker: in this sandbox `cd <repo> && git ...` triggers an approval prompt; use `git -C <dir>` and run python/grep from another cwd. A regex over conflict markers (keep both sides, append our entry last with comma fix) resolves additive activity-PR conflicts quickly.

Reviewer: cloning the repo is blocked in the sandbox; review via `gh pr diff`, `gh pr view --json files,comments` and `gh api repos/<o>/<r>/contents/<path>?ref=<sha> -q .content | base64 -d > /tmp/x.js` then `node --check`.

Reviewer: for merge-only re-reviews of child-page stacked PRs, use `gh api repos/<o>/<r>/compare/<old>...<new> -q '.files[].filename'` to confirm the activity's own js file is untouched, then check conflict markers (grep) and `node --check` on fetched files.

Reworker: for 'implement optional suggestions' on activity PRs, the 'confirm on a device' item is manual; do the code ones, post a blocking comment and apply human-decision-required (not ready-for-review).
